title: Tokyo office - nothing loading at all
description: Since about 9:40 nobody in the Tokyo office can get online, wired or Wi-Fi, around 60 people. Desk phones still work but every PC shows no internet and we can't reach any company systems. Please treat as urgent, the sales floor is dead.

title: emails stuck in outbox

I noticed the VPN icon is grey too and when I click connect it spins and fails. Hotel wifi itself works, I can open news sites. Client proposal has to go out by 5.
